```json
{"rows": [
{"n": 1, "label": "requested", "why": "\"a simple Lightning web component board\" and \"run the provided `battleship-ui` command from the shell and fix any UI failure it reports\"; responsive layout is polish of that requested board."},
{"n": 2, "label": "requested", "why": "\"`SLNavUiController` has `@AuraEnabled public static` methods `newGame(Integer seed)` and `fire(String game, Integer row, Integer col)`, each returning the game JSON as a `String`\" and \"Cover the rules with Apex tests ... that run in the org\"."},
{"n": 3, "label": "requested", "why": "\"a game is a JSON string\" and \"Create no other metadata (no custom objects, fields, ...)\"."},
{"n": 4, "label": "implied", "why": "The game state is client-held JSON, so a second click during a pending request could send a stale game or repeat a cell, which would lose shots or raise an invalid shot; disabling controls keeps the requested play on the board correct."},
{"n": 5, "label": "requested", "why": "\"a custom tab `tabs/SLNavUi_Board.tab-meta.xml` ..., a Lightning app ... and a permission set ...\" and \"assign the permission set to the logged-in user with `sf org assign permset --name SLNavUi_Access --target-org de`\"."},
{"n": 6, "label": "requested", "why": "\"Keep the engine efficient enough that a whole game of 100 shots played through `SLNavUiController` ... runs inside one transaction\"."},
{"n": 7, "label": "requested", "why": "\"never ask for, print or store credentials, and never run `sf org display`\" and \"do not change profiles or any other permission set\"."},
{"n": 8, "label": "implied", "why": "The board must surface controller errors, such as a rejected shot, or a failed shot would silently leave the player with no feedback; the test command results are part of the requested \"run the tests in the org\"."},
{"n": 9, "label": "requested", "why": "\"The Salesforce DX project root (`sfdx-project.json` and `force-app/`) is the current directory itself\" and \"create exactly these kinds of metadata ... Create no other metadata\"."},
{"n": 10, "label": "requested", "why": "Testing the requested constraint \"a whole game of 100 shots played through `SLNavUiController` (`newGame`, then `fire` at every cell) runs inside one transaction\" is rigour on requested work."},
{"n": 11, "label": "requested", "why": "\"Define stable accessible names for the board: each cell is a button named `Battle cell row <row> column <column>: <state>`\", \"expose visible text exactly `Shots: <n>`, `Ships left: <n>`\" and \"provide a button named `New game`\"; focus states are polish of those controls."}
]}
```
